 Gareth Gates returns to Singapore for 25th anniversary concert in January 2027
 SPINS 
 840 
 Estimated:   reading 
 Words by Hidzir Junaini 
 First published: 6 November 2026 
 Last updated: 6 November 2026 
 News 
 Gigs 
 Events 
 Gareth Gates is bringing a dose of early-2000s pop nostalgia to Singapore.
 The British singer will perform at Festive Arts Theatre at Our Tampines Hub on 22 January 2027 at 7 PM, marking his first full-length solo concert in Singapore and his return to the country’s stage after more than two decades.
 View this post on Instagram 
 A post shared by Mode Entertainment | Mode Live Productions (Singapore) (@modeent_sg) 
 Presented by Mode Live Production and Mode Entertainment , Gareth Gates 25th Anniversary Live in Singapore will celebrate 25 years since his debut, revisiting the songs that made him a familiar voice to a generation of pop fans.
 Gates rose to fame through Pop Idol , winning audiences over with his singing and his personal journey with a severe speech impediment. His upcoming anniversary show promises a live repertoire featuring favourites such as ‘Anyone of Us (Stupid Mistake)’ , ‘Say It Isn’t So’ , ‘Unchained Melody’ and ‘Spirit in the Sky’ .
 Fans can also look forward to ‘The Long and Winding Road’ , ‘Too Serious Too Soon’ , ‘Sunshine’ and ‘Will You Wait For Me’ , with the intimate theatre setting offering a chance to hear these songs up close.
 Tickets go on sale on 11 November 2026 at 10 AM SGT through Ticketmaster Singapore . Limited VIP packages will include premium seating and an individual photo opportunity with Gates. Ticket prices have not been provided in the announcement.
